task_instance: Take a small demultiplexed paired-end 16S dataset (2 samples, 5 read pairs each, Phred+33, with the 515F/806R-style primers still at the 5' ends) plus a tab-separated PairedEndFastqManifestPhred33V2 manifest and sample metadata, and process it into QIIME 2 ASVs and taxonomy (the skill's stated core deliverable: demux import, Cutadapt primer trim, DADA2 denoise-paired, feature-table summary, sklearn taxonomic classification, taxa barplot) with retained .qza/.qzv provenance and retention QC, using the bundled scripts/amplicon_workflow.py 'run' subcommand.
blocker_detail: The core deliverable requires the QIIME 2 2026.7 distribution (the 'qiime' CLI with the cutadapt/dada2/demux/feature-table/feature-classifier/taxa/types plugins), which is not installed on this workstation. The runner calls 'qiime info' and refuses to proceed unless every required plugin reports version 2026.7.x. No qiime binary is present, and no conda/mamba is available to install it; the skill itself states QIIME 2 must be installed through the official conda/container distribution and needs the network for installation and reference downloads, which this air-gapped runtime forbids. Separately, the 'run' step also requires a release-compatible TaxonomicClassifier serialized-sklearn artifact from a trusted source; none exists locally and obtaining one needs a network download, and per the run's additional rules I must not fabricate or stub that model. Only the offline pre-flight 'validate' subcommand (pure Python standard library) could run; the actual ASV/taxonomy generation could not.
evidence: Work dir /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/b273891e-4b73-5af7-9840-fc512af93809/scratchpad/real2_work/r045. Copied the bundled script to ./amplicon_workflow.py. Generated sample input with a stdlib-only -I generator (gen_sample.py): data/sample{A,B}_R{1,2}.fastq.gz (5 paired reads each, primers GTGCCAGCAGCCGCGGTAA / GGACTACAAGGGTATCTAAT at the 5' ends), plus tab-separated manifest.tsv and sample-metadata.tsv (verified with cat -A). The core 'run' invocation (same args plus --classifier compatible-classifier.qza --output run01) exited 1 with 'Error: Provide a release-compatible TaxonomicClassifier .qza' before any QIIME step, and even with a classifier it would next fail at the mandatory 'qiime info' runtime check because the QIIME 2 2026.7 CLI and plugins are absent and cannot be installed offline.
